articles.summary: Foralumab-treated subjects showed statistically significant and clinically significant improvements in Modified Fatigue Impact Scale (MFIS) scores compared with their own baseline scores after only 12 weeks of drug therapy.
articles.title: Tiziana Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 2a INFORM-MS Trial of Intranasal Foralumab in Non-Active Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis

articles.summary: Tiziana announced that it will host a conference call with KOLs to discuss the positive topline results from its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab in non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS).
articles.title: Tiziana to Host Investor Call with Key Opinion Leaders to Discuss Positive Phase 2a INFORM-MS Topline Results
